summary: File Inclusion vectors at instructions.php?doc= and /vulnerabilities/fi/?page=
body:
## File Inclusion Surfaces

1. **/instructions.php?doc=** - Allows ?doc=readme|PDF|changelog|copying|PHPIDS-license to include documentation files
2. **/vulnerabilities/fi/?page=** - Allows ?page=include.php|file1.php|file2.php|file3.php
   - Warning: allow_url_include is Disabled, so RFI not possible but LFI may work
